```{r}
long_to_wide <- function(df, id_col, name_col, value_cols) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = all_of(id_col),
      names_from = all_of(name_col),
      values_from = all_of(value_cols),
      names_sep = "_"
    )
  return(df2)
}

```

# Table 1
## Estimate Table 1 statistics
## Add function to calculate p-value for Table1


```{r}
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  
    # Construct vectors of data y, and groups (strata) g
    # Subset to two columns to ensure estimates do not include "Overall" for comp
    #
    x2 <- x[c(1,2)]
    y <- unlist(x2)
    g <- factor(rep(1:length(x2), times=sapply(x2, length)))
    
    if (is.numeric(y)) {
      
        # For numeric variables, perform a standard 2-sample t-test
        #p <- anova(lm(y ~ g))$Pr[1]
        p <- t.test(y ~ g)$p.value
    } else {
      
        # For categorical variables, perform a chi-squared test of independence
        #p <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(table(y, g))$p.value)
        #print(table(y,g))
        tabl <- table(y, g)
        if (any(tabl < 5)) {
          p <- fisher.test(tabl)$p.value
        }else{
          p <- chisq.test(tabl)$p.value  
        }
        
    }
    # Format the p-value, using an HTML entity for the less-than sign.
    # The initial empty string places the output on the line below the variable label.
    
    c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}
```

```{r}
library(broom)
run_lm <- function(model_name, outcome, predictor, covariates, data, outdir) {
  # Combine predictor and covariates into a formula string
  formula_str <- paste(outcome, " ~ ", paste(c(predictor, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  
  # Convert to formula object
  formula_obj <- as.formula(formula_str)
  
  # Fit linear model
  model <- lm(formula_obj, data = data)
  
  summary_output <- summary(model)
  conf <- confint(model, level = 0.95)
  
  df_ame <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)
  
  
  # File path
  output_file1 <- paste0(outdir, "/", model_name, "_summary.txt")

  # Capture the model summary and save it to a file
  
  # Save the summary to a text file
  capture.output(cat("Model Summary:\n"), summary_output, file = output_file1)
  
  # Append confidence intervals with header
  capture.output(cat("\nConfidence Intervals:\n"), conf, file = output_file1, append = TRUE)
  
  print(paste("Model summary saved to:", output_file1))
  
  print(summary_output)
  
  print(conf)
  
  output_file2 <- paste0(outdir, "/", model_name, "_ame.csv")
  
  # Save the data frame to a CSV file
  write.csv(df_ame, file = output_file2, row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(model)
}

```


```{r}
run_twopart <- function(model_name, outcome, predictor, covariates, data, outdir)
{
  # Combine predictor and covariates into a formula string
  formula_str <- paste(outcome, " ~ ", paste(c(predictor, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  
  # Convert to formula object
  formula_obj <- as.formula(formula_str)
  
  # Fit linear model
  model <- tpm(formula_part1 = formula_obj, formula_part2 = formula_obj, data = data, link_part1 = "logit", family_part2 = Gamma(link = "log"))
  
  # Capture the model summary and save it to a file
  summary_output <- summary(model)

  # File path
  output_file <- paste0(outdir, "/", model_name, "_summary.txt")
  
  # Save the summary to a text file
  capture.output(summary_output, file = output_file)
  
  print(paste("Model summary saved to:", output_file))

  df_ame <- AME(model)
  
  # File path
  output_file <- paste0(outdir, "/", model_name, "_ame.csv")
  
  # Save the data frame to a CSV file
  write.csv(df_ame, file = output_file, row.names = FALSE)
  
  print(paste("Model summary saved to:", output_file))
  
  print(summary_output)
  print(df_ame)

  return(model)
}
```

```{r}
run_loglik_ratio_test <- function(reduced_model, full_model, reduced_model_name, full_model_name) {
  reduced_loglik <- logLik(reduced_model)
  full_loglik <- logLik(full_model)

  lr_statistic <- 2 * (as.numeric(full_loglik) - as.numeric(reduced_loglik))
  df_diff <- attr(full_loglik, "df") - attr(reduced_loglik, "df")
  p_value <- pchisq(lr_statistic, df = df_diff, lower.tail = FALSE)

  data.frame(
    reduced_model = reduced_model_name,
    full_model = full_model_name,
    logLik_reduced = as.numeric(reduced_loglik),
    logLik_full = as.numeric(full_loglik),
    df_reduced = attr(reduced_loglik, "df"),
    df_full = attr(full_loglik, "df"),
    df_diff = df_diff,
    LR_statistic = lr_statistic,
    p_value = p_value
  )
}
```

# Secondary analysis
```{r}
outdir <- project_dir(c("results", "woMCI_7c_plus_se", "secondary"), create = TRUE)
```

```{r}
run_stratification_analysis <- function(str_var, str_value, model_prefix, covs, data, outdir) {
  ncovs <- c()
  
  df0 <- data %>% filter(.data[[str_var]] == str_value)
  
  # Set COUNTRY levels to match full dataset
  df0$COUNTRY <- droplevels(df0$COUNTRY)

  #Caregiver Informal Care costs
  
  #Unadjusted model
  model_name <- paste0("tpm_unadj_cinm_merged", model_prefix)
  run_twopart(model_name, "COST_COSTCAINM", "CG_SEX1", ncovs, df0, outdir)
  
  #Adjusted model
  
  model_name <- paste0("tpm_adj_cinm_merged", model_prefix)
  run_twopart(model_name, "COST_COSTCAINM", "CG_SEX1", covs, df0, outdir)
  
  # ZBI
  # unadjusted
  model_name <- paste0("lm_unadj_zbi_merged", model_prefix)
  run_lm(model_name, "ZBITOTB", "CG_SEX1", ncovs, df0, outdir)
  
  # adjusted
  model_name <- paste0("lm_adj_zbi_merged", model_prefix)
  run_lm(model_name, "ZBITOTB", "CG_SEX1", covs, df0, outdir)
}
```

# secondary analysis 2 - stratify by severity
EU: Patients were stratified according to disease severity at baseline using MMSE criteria consistent with
UK clinical guidelines [23]: 
‘Mild AD severity’ (MMSE 21−26 points); 
‘Moderate AD severity’ (MMSE 15−20 points); 
‘Moderately severe/severe AD severity’ (MMSE <15 points).

JP: Patients were classified into three groups (mild,
moderate, moderately severe/severe) based on the
AD severity at baseline using MMSE [24] criteria
consistent with the GERAS-I and United Kingdom
(UK) National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
(NICE) guidelines: mild, MMSE 21–26 points;
moderate, MMSE 15–20 points; and moderately
severe/severe, MMSE≤14 points [20, 25].

SPAIN/ITALY: Patients and caregivers were stratified into
three groups according to patient AD dementia
severity at baseline: mild (MMSE score 21–26),
moderate (MMSE score 15–20), and moderately
severe/severe (MS/S) AD dementia (MMSE
score <15).

US: During stage 2, uniform diagnostic criteria were
applied to classify patients as either MCI (Mini-
Mental State Examination [MMSE] score of 24 to 30
and a Functional Activities Questionnaire [FAQ] <6)
or MILD (mild dementia, MMSE score of 20 to 30 and an
FAQ >=6) [12].

# Appendix 4: sensitivity analysis -- test interaction 
```{r}
outdir <- project_dir(c("results", "woMCI_7c_plus_se", "sensitB_int"), create = TRUE)
```


# gender x AD severity
```{r}
merged_analysis <- df
merged_analysis$CG_SEX1 <- factor(merged_analysis$CG_SEX1)
merged_analysis$ADseverity <- factor(merged_analysis$ADseverity, levels = c("Mild", "Moderate", "Moderately severe/severe"))
merged_analysis$WORKYN <- factor(merged_analysis$WORKYN, levels = c("N", "Y"))
merged_analysis$COUNTRY <- relevel(factor(merged_analysis$COUNTRY), ref = "FRANCE")

add_cgsex_interactions <- function(data, modifier, ref_level, prefix, level_labels = NULL) {
  data[[modifier]] <- relevel(factor(data[[modifier]]), ref = ref_level)
  female_cg <- ifelse(is.na(data$CG_SEX1), NA_real_, ifelse(as.character(data$CG_SEX1) %in% c("2", "Female"), 1, 0))
  modifier_value <- as.character(data[[modifier]])
  interaction_vars <- character()

  for (level in setdiff(levels(data[[modifier]]), ref_level)) {
    label <- if (!is.null(level_labels) && level %in% names(level_labels)) level_labels[[level]] else level
    var_name <- paste0(prefix, "_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", label))
    var_name <- gsub("_$", "", var_name)

    data[[var_name]] <- ifelse(
      is.na(female_cg) | is.na(modifier_value),
      NA_real_,
      female_cg * as.numeric(modifier_value == level)
    )

    interaction_vars <- c(interaction_vars, var_name)
  }

  list(data = data, interaction_vars = interaction_vars)
}

covs_s1 <- setdiff(covs_primary, c("MMSETOTB"))
main_s1_tpm <- c("CG_SEX1", "ADseverity")
main_s1_lm <- c("CG_SEX1", "ADseverity")
int_s1_lm <- c("CG_SEX1", "ADseverity", "CG_SEX1:ADseverity")

s1_interactions <- add_cgsex_interactions(
  merged_analysis,
  modifier = "ADseverity",
  ref_level = "Mild",
  prefix = "INT_CGSEX1_ADseverity",
  level_labels = c("Moderately severe/severe" = "Severe")
)
merged_analysis <- s1_interactions$data
int_s1_tpm <- c("CG_SEX1", "ADseverity", s1_interactions$interaction_vars)
s1_interactions$interaction_vars
```

    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

fig2A

```{r}
df_long %>%
  filter(COUNTRY != "United States") %>%
  group_by(ADseverity, CG_SEX1) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    mean_cainm = round(mean(COST_COSTCAINM, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    std_cainm = round(sd(COST_COSTCAINM, na.rm = TRUE), 1), 
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


```


# Appendix 1: distribution of informal care costs
```{r}
figA1_data <- merged_analysis
figA1_data$COST_COSTCAINM_bi <- as.factor(ifelse(figA1_data$COST_COSTCAINM == 0, "no cost", "cost > 0"))

table(figA1_data$COST_COSTCAINM_bi)
```

```{r}
file_name <- paste0(outdir_orig, "FigA1-1_hist_InfCareCosts", ".png")
  
png(file_name, width = 1200, height = 900, res = 150)
  
# distribution of Informal Care Costs, Fig A1-1
hist(figA1_data$COST_COSTCAINM, 
     main = "Histogram of Informal care costs",
     xlab = "Caregiver Informal Care Costs",
     ylab = "Frequency",
     col = "skyblue",
     border = "black",
     breaks = 50  
)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
severity_levels <- c("Mild", "Moderate", "Moderately severe/severe")
severity_titles <- c("Mild", "Moderate", "Severe")

severity_plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(severity_levels)) {
  severity <- severity_levels[i]
  subset_df <- subset(figA1_data, ADseverity == severity)

  p <- ggplot(subset_df, aes(x = COST_COSTCAINM)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
    labs(
      title = severity_titles[i],
      x = "Caregiver Informal Care Costs",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  severity_plot_list[[severity_titles[i]]] <- p
}
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

FigA1_2_hist <- wrap_plots(severity_plot_list, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)

file_name <- paste0(outdir_orig, "FigA1-2_hist_by_ADseverity", ".png")

ggsave(file_name,
       FigA1_2_hist,
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(stringr)

countries <- c("FRANCE", "GERMANY", "ITALY", "UNITED KINGDOM", "SPAIN", "Japan", "US")

plot_list <- list()

for (ct in countries) {
  subset_df <- subset(figA1_data, COUNTRY == ct)

  ct_name <- ct
  if (ct == "US"){
    ct_name = "United States"
  }
  ct_name <- str_to_title(ct_name)

    
  p <- ggplot(subset_df, aes(x = COST_COSTCAINM)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
    labs(
      title = ct_name,
      x = "Caregiver Informal Care Costs",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  plot_list[[ct]] <- p
}
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

FigA1_4_hist <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2, nrow = 4)

file_name <- paste0(outdir_orig, "FigA1-4_hist_by_country", ".png")

ggsave(file_name,
       FigA1_4_hist,
       width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```
